name: Cortisol cocktail

card.summary: A viral non-alcoholic drink of coconut water, orange juice, lemon, magnesium and sea salt that fans say calms stress, which they link to energy, skin and a less bloated look.
card.note: People with kidney disease or diabetes are advised by physicians to check first.

quick.overview:
The cortisol cocktail is a TikTok-era mocktail, often served in a wine glass, made from coconut water, orange juice, squeezed lemon, magnesium powder, a pinch of sea salt and sparkling water [1]. Fans say it lowers stress hormones and supports energy, sleep and a fresher appearance.

The appearance chain proposed is lower stress, better sleep and hydration, and so clearer skin and less puffiness. Physicians quoted in news coverage say they know of no strong studies of the drink and that hydration is its plausible benefit [1].
quick.how: People mix it as a daily or morning drink, usually in place of coffee or as an afternoon pick-me-up.
quick.risks: Experts quoted by NBC say people with chronic kidney disease should avoid it because of magnesium and potassium, and people with diabetes should be cautious about the juice sugar [1].

lead: The cortisol cocktail is an alcohol-free drink that went viral on TikTok, combining coconut water, orange juice, lemon, magnesium powder, sea salt and sparkling water [1]. Posters present it as a way to lower stress hormones.

Cortisol is a glucocorticoid stress hormone that follows a daily rhythm, and chronically high levels are associated with muscle loss and reduced bone formation [2]. Followers of fitness and appearance communities link lower stress to better recovery, sleep and skin.
Two physicians quoted in news coverage said they were not aware of studies of the ingredients on cortisol, and that the drink may aid hydration [1].

chain: Drink supplies fluid, minerals and magnesium
Better sleep and recovery, as claimed
angle.text: Fans drink it to feel calmer and more hydrated, expecting better sleep and a less drawn, puffy appearance. The effect on cortisol itself is claimed by proponents.

infobox: Coconut water, orange juice, lemon, magnesium, sea salt

paras: Videos show the drink assembled and sipped from a wine glass, often framed as a daily ritual [1].

Proponents say it balances adrenal function and reduces stress hormones. Cortisol is released in a daily pattern and raised during stress, and prolonged elevation affects muscle, bone and immunity [2].

Stanford endocrinologist Marilyn Tan said cortisol is necessary and doctors rarely try to lower it; Jessica Lee of the University of Maryland said no strong studies exist on the drink and that magnesium is the one ingredient possibly linked to stress [1].
Physicians cited by NBC advise people with chronic kidney disease to avoid it and people with diabetes to be cautious [1].

lore.intro: Mentioned in lifestyle and training forums in discussions of cortisol and stress management.

claims.believers: TikTok users say it calms stress and improves energy [1].
claims.experts: Physicians quoted say they know of no studies of its effect on cortisol [1].
